title: Three toolbar directions for Excalidraw
summary: Compare a roomier toolbar, a compact layout with visible shortcuts, and a bright red toolbar that names the active tool. The original toolbar remains the default.

variations.name: Room to Draw
variations.idea: More space between larger targets, in the same familiar toolbar.

variations.name: Technical Rail
variations.idea: A compact instrument rail with labeled tool groups and visible shortcut keycaps.

variations.name: Red Command Bar
variations.idea: A bright red toolbar with a dedicated readout for the current tool.
